End-to-end HTTP test: a real server thread on an ephemeral port, driven\n//! over raw HTTP/1.1 with `TcpStream` (no client dependencies).\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::thread;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse pfa::http::serve_listener;\nuse std::net::TcpListener;\n\nstatic SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_db() -> PathBuf {\n    let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_nanos();\n    let seq = SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"pfa-test-{}-{}-{}.db\", std::process::id(), nanos, seq));\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&p);\n    p\n}\n\nstruct Server {\n    addr: String,\n    path: PathBuf,\n}\n\nfn spawn_server(block_size: u32) -> Server {\n    let path = temp_db();\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let p2 = path.clone();\n    thread::spawn(move || {\n        serve_listener(listener, p2, block_size, true).unwrap();\n    });\n    let s = Server { addr, path };\n    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n    s\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn request(addr: &str, method: &str, target: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let body = body.unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let req = format!(\n        \"{method} {target} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let (head, body_part) = text.split_once(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap_or((&text, \"\"));\n    let status = head\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    Resp {\n        status,\n        body: body_part.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn extract_str<'a>(json: &'a str, key: &str) -> &'a str {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\\\"\");\n    let start = json.find(&pat).unwrap() + pat.len();\n    let rest = &json[start..];\n    let end = rest.find('\"').unwrap();\n    &rest[..end]\n}\n\nimpl Drop for Server {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&self.path);\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn full_lifecycle_over_http() {\n    let s = spawn_server(256);\n\n    // health\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/health\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"\"));\n\n    // put two records (hex payload)\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let h1 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data\":\"plain text\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let _h2 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n\n    // get back the hex record\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"48656c6c6f\\\"\"), \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // overwrite in place (same length)\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"576f726c6421\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"576f726c6421\\\"\"));\n\n    // length mismatch -> 422\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"00\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 422, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // free, then double-free and stale read -> 409\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"DELETE\",\n        &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"),\n        None,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"DELETE\",\n        &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"),\n        None,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"double free must be 409, got {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"stale read must be 409\");\n\n    // stats + partitions\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"page_count\\\":1\"));\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/partitions\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"kind\\\":\\\"free\\\"\"));\n\n    // compact + reopen survive\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/compact\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/reopen\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // unknown route -> 400\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/nope\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn file_persists_across_server_restart() {\n    let bs = 256u32;\n    let path = {\n        let s = spawn_server(bs);\n        let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"deadbeef\"}\"#));\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n        let h = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n        assert_eq!(\n            request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h}\"), None).body,\n        );\n        // sanity: handle reads expected bytes\n        let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h}\"), None);\n        assert!(r.body.contains(\"deadbeef\"));\n        s.path.clone()\n        // server thread keeps running with the std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::thread;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse pfa::http::serve_listener;\nuse std::net::TcpListener;\n\nstatic SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_db() -> PathBuf {\n    let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_nanos();\n    let seq = SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"pfa-test-{}-{}-{}.db\", std::process::id(), nanos, seq));\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&p);\n    p\n}\n\nstruct Server {\n    addr: String,\n    path: PathBuf,\n}\n\nfn spawn_server(block_size: u32) -> Server {\n    let path = temp_db();\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let p2 = path.clone();\n    thread::spawn(move || {\n        serve_listener(listener, p2, block_size, true).unwrap();\n    });\n    let s = Server { addr, path };\n    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n    s\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn request(addr: &str, method: &str, target: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let body = body.unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let req = format!(\n        \"{method} {target} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let (head, body_part) = text.split_once(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap_or((&text, \"\"));\n    let status = head\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    Resp {\n        status,\n        body: body_part.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn extract_str<'a>(json: &'a str, key: &str) -> &'a str {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\\\"\");\n    let start = json.find(&pat).unwrap() + pat.len();\n    let rest = &json[start..];\n    let end = rest.find('\"').unwrap();\n    &rest[..end]\n}\n\nimpl Drop for Server {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&self.path);\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn full_lifecycle_over_http() {\n    let s = spawn_server(256);\n\n    // health\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/health\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"\"));\n\n    // put two records (hex payload)\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let h1 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data\":\"plain text\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let _h2 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n\n    // get back the hex record\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"48656c6c6f\\\"\"), \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // overwrite in place (same length)\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"576f726c6421\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"576f726c6421\\\"\"));\n\n    // length mismatch -> 422\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"00\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 422, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // free, then double-free and stale read -> 409\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"DELETE\",\n        &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"),\n        None,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"DELETE\",\n        &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"),\n        None,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"double free must be 409, got {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"stale read must be 409\");\n\n    // stats + partitions\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"page_count\\\":1\"));\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/partitions\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"kind\\\":\\\"free\\\"\"));\n\n    // compact + reopen survive\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/compact\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/reopen\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // unknown route -> 400\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/nope\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn file_persists_across_server_restart() {\n    let bs = 256u32;\n    let path = {\n let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h}\"), None);\n        assert!(r.body.contains(\"deadbeef\"));\n        s.path.clone()\n        // server thread keeps running with the file open; remove from temp on\n        // drop. For the restart check use a dedicated file instead.\n    };\n    let _ = path;\n\n    // Dedicated restart scenario with our own listener lifecycle.\n    let db = temp_db();\n    {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n        let p = db.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || serve_listener(listener, p, bs, true).unwrap());\n        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n        let r = request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"cafe\"}\"#));\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n        // Dropping the OS listener does not remove the file; the thread is\n        // detached but the data was fsynced per request.\n        drop(listener);\n        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));\n    }\n    {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n        let p = db.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || serve_listener(listener, p, bs, true).unwrap());\n        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n        // The record persists; verify via stats (alloc_counter restored).\n        let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n        assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"alloc_counter\\\":1\"), \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    }\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&db);\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a6310311-c260-4a71-815d-f7be684ad771","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let (head, body_part) = End-to-end HTTP test: a real server thread on an ephemeral port, driven\n//! over raw HTTP/1.1 with `TcpStream` (no client dependencies).\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::thread;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse pfa::http::serve_listener;\nuse std::net::TcpListener;\n\nstatic SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_db() -> PathBuf {\n    let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_nanos();\n    let seq = SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"pfa-test-{}-{}-{}.db\", std::process::id(), nanos, seq));\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&p);\n    p\n}\n\nstruct Server {\n    addr: String,\n    path: PathBuf,\n}\n\nfn spawn_server(block_size: u32) -> Server {\n    let path = temp_db();\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let p2 = path.clone();\n    thread::spawn(move || {\n        serve_listener(listener, p2, block_size, true).unwrap();\n    });\n    let s = Server { addr, path };\n    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n    s\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn request(addr: &str, method: &str, target: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let body = body.unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let req = format!(\n        \"{method} {target} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let (head, body_part) = text.split_once(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap_or((&text, \"\"));\n    let status = head\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    Resp {\n        status,\n        body: body_part.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn extract_str<'a>(json: &'a str, key: &str) -> &'a str {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\\\"\");\n    let start = json.find(&pat).unwrap() + pat.len();\n    let rest = &json[start..];\n    let end = rest.find('\"').unwrap();\n    &rest[..end]\n}\n\nimpl Drop for Server {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&self.path);\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn full_lifecycle_over_http() {\n    let s = spawn_server(256);\n\n    // health\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/health\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"\"));\n\n    // put two records (hex payload)\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let h1 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data\":\"plain text\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let _h2 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n\n    // get back the hex record\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"48656c6c6f\\\"\"), \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // overwrite in place (same length)\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"576f726c6421\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"576f726c6421\\\"\"));\n\n    // length mismatch -> 422\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"00\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 422, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // free, then double-free and stale read -> 409\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"DELETE\",\n        &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"),\n        None,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"DELETE\",\n        &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"),\n        None,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"double free must be 409, got {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"stale read must be 409\");\n\n    // stats + partitions\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"page_count\\\":1\"));\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/partitions\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"kind\\\":\\\"free\\\"\"));\n\n    // compact + reopen survive\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/compact\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/reopen\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // unknown route -> 400\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/nope\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn file_persists_across_server_restart() {\n    let bs = 256u32;\n    let db = temp_db();\n    {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n        let p = db.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || serve_listener(listener, p, bs, true).unwrap());\n        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n        let r = request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"cafef00d\"}\"#));\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n        let h = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n        let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", The directory itself then does not have to grow.\n        let dead_slot = self.slots.iter().position(|s| s.len == 0);\n\n        if let Some(si) = dead_slot {\n            match self.free.iter().position(|(_, l)| *l as u32 >= need) {\n                Some(fi) => return self.place_in_interval(si, fi, len),\n                // Record fits nowhere; growing the directory could not help.\n                None => {\n                    return Err(Error::OutOfSpace {\n                        page: self.pid,\n                        needed: len as usize,\n                        free_total: self.free_bytes(),\n                        largest: self.free.iter().map(|(_, l)| *l as usize).max().unwrap_or(0),\n                        hint: \"run compact to defragment the page\".into(),\n                    })\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // No dead slot: the directory must grow by SLOT_LEN bytes. That growth\n        // is taken from the head free interval (the one abutting the\n        // directory), which must therefore also contain the record bytes.\n        let fi = match self.free.iter().position(|(o, _)| *o as u32 == ds) {\n            Some(i) if self.free[i].1 as u32 >= SLOT_LEN + need => i,\n            _ => {\n                return Err(Error::OutOfSpace {\n                    page: self.pid,\n                    needed: len as usize,\n                    free_total: self.free_bytes(),\n                    largest: self.free.iter().map(|(_, l)| *l as usize).max().unwrap_or(0),\n                    hint: \"page full or fragmented; run compact to defragment\".into(),\n                })\n            }\n        };\n        self.place_with_dir_growth(fi, len)\n    }\n\n    /// Place a record reusing existing dead slot `si` inside free interval\n    /// `fi`, splitting the interval (free piece stays at the low end).\n    fn place_in_interval(&mut self, si: usize, fi: usize, len: u16) -> Result<(usize, u32)> {\n        let (start, ilen) = self.free[fi];\n        let need = len as u32;\n        let rec_start = (start as u32 + ilen as u32 - need) as u16;\n        // A dead slot's stored generation was already advanced when the\n        // previous incarnation was freed, so it IS the never-issued generation\n        // for the new incarnation. (Gen 0 is reserved for \"never issued\".)\n        let gen = self.slots[si].gen;\n        debug_assert_ne!(gen, 0, \"dead slot must carry a post-free generation\");\n        self.slots[si] = Slot {\n            off: rec_start,\n            len,\n            gen,\n        };\n        self.alloc_count = self.alloc_count.wrapping_add(1);\n        // Split: low remainder remains free (may be zero length).\n        self.free.remove(fi);\n        if rec_start > start {\n            self.free.push((start, rec_start - start));\n            self.free.sort_unstable_by_key(|(o, _)| *o);\n        }","numLines":130,"startLine":300,"totalLines":690}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8edd9863-c590-47e0-95ac-8330d43d5006","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

bool,\n    repo: Option<Repository<FileStorage>>,\n}\n\n/// Run the HTTP server until the process is killed.\npub fn serve(\n    path: PathBuf,\n    block_size: u32,\n    addr: &str,\n    durable: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n    eprintln!(\"pfa listening on http://{addr} (block_size={block_size})\");\n    serve_loop(listener, path, block_size, durable, &AtomicBool::new(false))\n}\n\n/// Accept loop shared by the blocking production entry point and the\n/// shutdown-able test entry point. The listener is put in non-blocking mode so\n/// the loop can poll `shutdown` roughly every 20 ms instead of being stuck in\n/// `accept(2)` forever.\nfn serve_loop(\n    listener: TcpListener,\n    path: PathBuf,\n    block_size: u32,\n    durable: bool,\n    shutdown: &AtomicBool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    listener.set_nonblocking(true)?;\n    let create = !path.exists() || std::fs::metadata(&path)?.len() == 0;\n    let storage = FileStorage::open(&path, block_size)?;\n    let mut repo = if create {\n        Repository::create(storage, block_size)?\n    } else {\n        Repository::open(storage, block_size)?\n    };\n    repo.set_durable(durable);\n    let state = Mutex::new(AppState {\n        path,\n        block_size,\n        durable,\n        repo: Some(repo),\n    });\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"pfa listening on http://{} (block_size={block_size})\",\n        listener.local_addr()?\n    );\n    while !shutdown.load(Ordering::Acquire) {\n        match listener.accept() {\n            Ok((stream, _peer)) => {\n                // Blocking I/O is fine once a connection is established.\n                listener.set_nonblocking(false).ok();\n                stream.set_nodelay(true).ok();\n                stream\n                    .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(10)))\n                    .ok();\n                if let Err(e) = handle_connection(stream, &state) {\n                    eprintln!(\"connection error: {e}\");\n                }\n                listener.set_nonblocking(true).ok();\n            }\n            Err(ref e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {\n                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    // Dropping `state` closes the repository's file handle, so another process\n    // or test server can open the same path immediately afterwards.\n    drop(state);\n    drop(listener);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Handle for a test/server instance that can be shut down deterministically.\npub struct TestServer {\n    addr: String,\n    path: PathBuf,\n    shutdown: std::sync::Arc<AtomicBool>,\n    thread: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<Result<()>>>,\n}\n\nimpl TestServer {\n    /// Start a server on an ephemeral port over `path` (created if absent).\n    pub fn start(path: PathBuf, block_size: u32) -> std::io::Result<Self> {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127..0.1:0\".strip_prefix('.').unwrap_or(\"127.0.0.1:0\"))?;\n        let addr = listener.local_addr()?.to_string();\n        let shutdown = std::sync::Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));\n        let sd = std::sync::Arc::clone(&shutdown);\n        let p = path.clone();\n        let thread = std::thread::spawn(move || {\n            serve_loop(listener, p, block_size, true, &sd)\n        });\n        // Wait for the listener to be serving.\n        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n        Ok(Self {\n            addr,\n            path,\n            shutdown,\n            thread: Some(thread),\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn addr(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.addr\n    }\n\n    pub fn path(&self) -> &std::path::Path {\n        &self.path\n    }\n\n    /// Signal shutdown and wait for the server thread (and its file handle)\n    /// to be released.\n    pub fn shutdown(mut self) {\n        self.shutdown.store(true, Ordering::Release);\n        if let Some(t) = self.thread.take() {\n            let _ = t.join();\n        }\n    }\n}"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_51f8dab30f38c6836ffdb82b","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":942,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":98104,"output_tokens":2803,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"08779156-c084-4e42-94c8-b5b0e0b1f7ad","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:37:22.491Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

End-to-end HTTP test: a real server thread on an ephemeral port, driven\n//! over raw HTTP/1.1 with `TcpStream` (no client dependencies).\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse pfa::http::TestServer;\n\nstatic SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_db() -> PathBuf {\n    let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_nanos();\n    let seq = SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"pfa-test-{}-{}-{}.db\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        nanos,\n        seq\n    ));\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&p);\n    p\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn request(addr: &str, method: &str, target: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let body = body.unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let req = format!(\n        \"{method} {target} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let (head, body_part) = text.split_once(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap_or((&text, \"\"));\n    let status = head\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    Resp {\n        status,\n        body: body_part.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn extract_str<'a>(json: &'a str, key: &str) -> &'a str {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\\\"\");\n    let start = json.find(&pat).expect(\"key present\") + pat.len();\n    let rest = &json[start..];\n    let end = rest.find('\"').unwrap();\n    &rest[..end]\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn full_lifecycle_over_http() {\n    let path = temp_db();\n    let srv = TestServer::start(path.clone(), 256).unwrap();\n    let addr = srv.addr().to_string();\n\n    // health\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/health\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"\"));\n\n    // put two records (hex payload + std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::thread;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse pfa::http::serve_listener;\nuse std::net::TcpListener;\n\nstatic SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_db() -> PathBuf {\n    let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_nanos();\n    let seq = SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"pfa-test-{}-{}-{}.db\", std::process::id(), nanos, seq));\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&p);\n    p\n}\n\nstruct Server {\n    addr: String,\n    path: PathBuf,\n}\n\nfn spawn_server(block_size: u32) -> Server {\n    let path = temp_db();\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let p2 = path.clone();\n    thread::spawn(move || {\n        serve_listener(listener, p2, block_size, true).unwrap();\n    });\n    let s = Server { addr, path };\n    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n    s\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn request(addr: &str, method: &str, target: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let body = body.unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let req = format!(\n        \"{method} {target} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let (head, body_part) = text.split_once(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap_or((&text, \"\"));\n    let status = head\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    Resp {\n        status,\n        body: body_part.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn extract_str<'a>(json: &'a str, key: &str) -> &'a str {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\\\"\");\n    let start = json.find(&pat).unwrap() + pat.len();\n    let rest = &json[start..];\n    let end = rest.find('\"').unwrap();\n    &rest[..end]\n}\n\nimpl Drop for Server {\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&self.path);\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn full_lifecycle_over_http() {\n    let s = spawn_server(256);\n\n    // health\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/health\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"\"));\n\n    // put two records (hex payload)\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let h1 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data\":\"plain text\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let _h2 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n\n    // get back the hex record\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"48656c6c6f\\\"\"), \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // overwrite in place (same length: \"Hello\" -> \"Aloha\")\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"416c6f6861\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"416c6f6861\\\"\"));\n\n    // length mismatch -> 422\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"00\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 422, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // free, then double-free and stale read -> 409\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"DELETE\",\n        &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"),\n        None,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = request(\n        &s.addr,\n        \"DELETE\",\n        &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"),\n        None,\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"double free must be 409, got {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"stale read must be 409\");\n\n    // stats + partitions\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"page_count\\\":1\"));\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/partitions\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"kind\\\":\\\"free\\\"\"));\n\n    // compact + reopen survive\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/compact\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"POST\", \"/reopen\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // unknown route -> 400\n    let r = request(&s.addr, \"GET\", \"/nope\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn file_persists_across_server_restart() {\n    let bs = 256u32;\n    let db = temp_db();\n    {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n        let p = db.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || serve_listener(listener, p, bs, true).unwrap());\n        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n        let r = request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"cafef00d\"}\"#));\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n        let h = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n        let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h}\"), None);\n        assert!(r.body.contains(\"cafef00d\"));\n    }\n    // Open a second server over the SAME file after the first listener is\n    // gone. Data is re-read and checksummed from disk.\n    {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n        let p = db.clone();\n        thread::spawn(move || serve_listener(listener, p, bs, true).unwrap());\n        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));\n        let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n        assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n        assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"alloc_counter\\\":1\"), \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    }\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&db);\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5851573c-7138-430b-9dbb-ddbbeb3d5448","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

{"parentUuid":"66ef5480-f7d9-4f2e-a43b-e70a5073e1ec","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_j9kch86haufnhqw0dt51uo2a","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b/README.md","content":"# pfa — 页级空闲空间分配器（纯后端）\n\n一个用 Rust 实现的、**文件支持的**可变长记录存储库，外加一个用于本地验证的\n零依赖 HTTP 入口。核心演示内容：\n\n- 可变长记录的**槽位页（slotted page）分配器**；\n- 空闲区由互不相交的**字节区间**表示，分配时**分裂**、释放时**相邻合并**；\n- 记录句柄 `Handle = (page, slot, generation)` 携带**代次**：槽位可复用，\n  但删除后旧句柄（use-after-free / double-free）一律被拒绝；\n- **页内压缩（compaction）**只搬移字节偏移，槽位号与代次不变，所有未失效\n  句柄的语义保持有效；\n- 明确的**磁盘格式**与**同步边界**：每个逻辑修改 = 一次整块写入（+ 可选\n  `fsync`），页尾 CRC-32 使撕裂写/位翻转在重新打开时被检出；\n- **可注入 I/O 层**：真实文件、内存镜像、以及可按计划注入 I/O 错误和字节\n  损坏的装饰器，故障测试走与生产完全相同的分配器代码路径；\n- **区间参考模型**：与分配器实现相互独立，随机差分测试逐步校验\n  “无重叠 + 空间守恒 + 句柄/载荷语义”。\n\n无任何第三方 crate 依赖（仅 Rust 标准库）。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```text\nCargo.toml\nsrc/\n  main.rs       CLI 入口（serve / check）\n  lib.rs        crate 导出\n  crc.rs        CRC-32（IEEE，poly 0xEDB88320）\n  io.rs         Storage trait：FileStorage / MemStorage / FaultyStorage\n  page.rs       槽位页：区间分裂合并、代次、压缩、分区不变量\n  repo.rs       文件支持的仓库：文件头、多页、同步边界\n  handle.rs     句柄类型 p<page>.s<slot>.g<gen>\n  reference.rs  区间参考模型\n  err.rs        错误类型\n  http.rs       零依赖本地 HTTP/1.1 验证服务\ntests/\n  common/mod.rs    测试辅助（确定性 PRNG、分区/守恒断言）\n  acceptance.rs    碎片化、重复释放、旧句柄、压缩、随机差分\n  faults.rs        故障注入（写错、fsync 错、位翻转、重读校验）\n  http_api.rs      真实 TCP 端到端测试\nexamples/\n  requests.http    HTTP 请求样例\nREADME.md\nRUN_LOG.md        实际运行命令与结果记录\n```\n\n## 磁盘格式\n\n所有整数均为小端序。块大小 `block_size` 可配置（默认 4096；测试常用 256\n以快速制造碎片）。\n\n### 文件布局\n\n| 文件块 | 内容 |\n|---|---|\n| 0 | 文件头（占满一个块） |\n| `pid + 1` | 页 `pid` |\n\n### 文件头（块 0）\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 0 | 4 | magic `PFAB` (`0x50464142`) |\n| 4 | 4 | 格式版本（当前 `1`） |\n| 8 | 4 | 块大小 |\n| 12 | 4 | 页数 |\n| 16 | 8 | 累计分配次数（摘要值；权威计数在各页头） |\n| 24 … bs-5 | | 保留，填 0 |\n| bs-4 | 4 | 对 `[0, bs-4)` 的 CRC-32 |\n\n### 页格式（块 `pid+1`）\n\n```text\n偏移 0                      页头 16 字节\n偏移 16                     槽位目录：每项 12 字节，向高地址增长\n          …… 空闲/记录数据区（若干互不相交区间）……\n偏移 bs-4                   对 [0, bs-4) 的 CRC-32\n```\n\n页头：\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 0 | 4 | magic `PFA1` (`0x50464131`) |\n| 4 | 4 | 页 id（必须等于其块序号 - 1） |\n| 8 | 2 | 槽位数（含已死槽位） |\n| 10 | 2 | 空闲区间数（加载时重建并与此值核对） |\n| 12 | 4 | 本页累计分配次数 |\n\n槽位项（12 字节）：\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 0 | 2 | 记录偏移；`length=0` 时该槽位已死 |\n| 2 | 2 | 记录长度（0 表示死槽位） |\n| 4 | 4 | 代次 generation（每次释放递增；0 保留为“从未签发”） |\n| 8 | 4 | 保留填 0 |\n\n空闲区间**不落盘**：加载时由存活记录重新构建，并与页头记录的区间数比对，\n任何不一致都报 `Corrupt`。\n\n## 同步与崩溃边界\n\n- 普通修改（`put` / `set` / `free` / `compact`）末尾恰好：\n  1. 一次整页 `write_block`（固定偏移、整块、带 CRC）；\n  2. 一次 `sync`（默认映射到 `File::sync_all`，即 `fsync`；`--no-sync`\n     或 `set_durable(false)` 可关闭）。\n- 追加新页是唯一触碰两个块的操作：**先写文件头（页数 +1），再写新页**。\n 若两步之间崩溃，最坏情况是留下一个未被引用的尾页；以 CRC 保护的文件头\n 页数为准重新打开。\n- 撕裂写 / 静默位翻转由页尾与文件头的 CRC-32 在下次打开时检出，报\n  `Corrupt`，不会被当成有效数据解释。\n\n## 分配与碎片策略\n\n- 首次适应（first-fit），在命中的空闲区间**高端**放置记录，因此一次分配\n  至多把一个空闲区间切成一个低端剩余块。\n- 释放时把记录区间插回有序空闲表，并与两侧相邻区间**合并**。\n- 死槽位优先复用（目录不增长）；否则目录从贴邻的头部空闲区间增长 12 字节。\n- `compact` 把存活记录自上而下打包到数据区顶端，空闲区合并为单一区间；\n  **槽位号与代次不变**，仅字节偏移移动，故有效句柄继续可用。\n- 仓库级 `put` 按页序 first-fit；现有页都放不下时追加新页。\n\n## 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\n\n# 启动本地验证服务（默认 127.0.0.1:8080，文件 pfa.db，块大小 4096）\n./target/release/pfa serve --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --file /tmp/pfa.db --block-size 4096\n\n# 校验已有文件并重读所有 CRC / 分区不变量，打印统计\n./target/release/pfa check --file /tmp/pfa.db --block-size 4096\n```\n\n## HTTP 接口\n\n载荷以十六进制字符串 `data_hex` 传输（也支持 UTF-8 的 `data`）。\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| GET | `/health` | 健康检查 |\n| POST | `/records` | 写入：`{\"data_hex\":\"…\"}` → `{\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\"}` |\n| GET | `/records?handle=p0.s0.g1` | 读取（旧句柄 → 409） |\n| PUT | `/records` | 同长度原地改写：`{\"handle\":\"…\",\"data_hex\":\"…\"}` |\n| DELETE | `/records?handle=…` | 释放（重复释放 → 409） |\n| POST | `/free` | 同上，句柄放 JSON body |\n| POST | `/compact` | `{}` 压缩全部页，或 `{\"page\":0}` |\n| GET | `/stats` | 页数、存活记录、空闲字节/区间数、每分配计数 |\n| GET | `/partitions` | 每页 free/live 区间的参考模型快照 |\n| POST | `/reopen` | 关闭并重新打开文件，重放全部校验 |\n\n可直接用 `examples/requests.http` 中的样例（curl 版见下）。\n\n```bash\ncurl -s -X POST localhost:8080/records -d '{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}'\n# {\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\",\"bytes\":5}\n\ncurl -s 'localhost:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1'\n# {\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\",\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\",\"bytes\":5}\n\ncurl -s -X DELETE 'localhost:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1'\ncurl -s -X DELETE 'localhost:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1'\n# 第二次：HTTP 409 stale_handle（代次已推进，槽位复用也读不到新数据）\n```\n\n## 测试\n\n```bash\ncargo test\n```\n\n测试矩阵：\n\n- **碎片化 → 压缩**：交错分配/释放制造多个小空洞，断言最大空洞小于空闲\n  总量、压缩后合并为单区间且存活句柄载荷不变；\n- **重复释放 / 释放后访问 / 槽位复用后旧句柄访问**：全部以代次判定拒绝；\n- **压缩保持句柄语义**：压缩后、以及关闭重开后，所有有效句柄仍读出原字节；\n- **随机差分（40 个种子 × 400 步）**：分配/读/释放/原地改写/压缩/重开，\n  每一步对照区间参考模型检查无重叠、精确覆盖、空间守恒与载荷一致；\n- **故障注入**：写错误、fsync 错误、`after` 计数定时、页/文件头位翻转后\n  重开被 CRC 捕获、读错误传播；\n- **HTTP 端到端**：真实 TCP 上跑完整生命周期，含服务器重启后文件持久化。\n\n## 范围说明\n\n这是教学/验证性质的后端项目：HTTP 服务只监听本地、单线程互斥、无鉴权，\nJSON 解析仅支持本服务使用的扁平请求体；没有前端。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_b775fcf3241c93b99a7cb13f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":305,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":105272,"output_tokens":6145,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"f7c682b5-30f6-4fde-99dc-64b2e7dff006","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:44:12.022Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

总量、压缩后合并为单区间且存活句柄载荷不变；\n- **重复释放 / 释放后访问 / 槽位复用后旧句柄访问**：全部以代次判定拒绝；\n- **压缩保持句柄语义**：压缩后、以及关闭重开后，所有有效句柄仍读出原字节；\n- **随机差分（40 个种子 × 400 步）**：分配/读/释放/原地改写/压缩/重开，\n  每一步对照区间参考模型检查无重叠、精确覆盖、空间守恒与载荷一致；\n- **故障注入**：写错误、fsync 错误、`after` 计数定时、页/文件头位翻转后\n  重开被 CRC 捕获、读错误传播；\n- **HTTP 端到端**：真实 TCP 上跑完整生命周期，含服务器重启后文件持久化。\n\n## 范围说明\n\n这是教学/验证性质的后端项目：HTTP 服务只监听本地、单线程互斥、无鉴权，\nJSON 解析仅支持本服务使用的扁平请求体；没有前端。\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f7c682b5-30f6-4fde-99dc-64b2e7dff006","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}
{"type":"last-prompt","lastPrompt":"从空目录开发“页级空闲空间分配”纯后端项目。用Rust实现文件支持的存储库及本地HTTP验证入口，明确磁盘格式和同步边界；用可注入I/O层模拟故障。实现可变长记录页分配器，空闲区分裂合并，句柄含代次防止删除后复用误读；压缩页时保持有效句柄语义。验收：构造碎片化分配、重复释放和旧句柄访问，用区间参考模型检查无重叠及空间守恒。交付源码、README、请求样例与自动化测试；实际运行并如实记录命令、结果和…","leafUuid":"3e444477-7e14-46b6-be4a-b42a67289a25","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82"}

{"parentUuid":"153b5d3e-f712-4ad5-ae63-9ca04a907d15","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ms6ua0jms8q47uz6pfc052ge","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b/examples/requests.http","content":"### pfa HTTP 请求样例\n###\n### 用法（需要一个运行中的服务）：\n###   cargo run -- serve --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --file /tmp/pfa.db --block-size 4096\n###\n### 本文档同时给出 curl 等价命令。注意：返回的句柄中的代次会随释放/复用\n### 递增，下面的 p0.s0.g1 以“全新数据库上的第一次写入”为例。\n\n### 健康检查\nGET http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n\n# curl:\n# curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n\n### 写入记录（hex 载荷 \"Hello\"）\nPOST http://127.0.0.1:8080/records\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}\n\n# curl:\n# curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/records -d '{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}'\n# -> {\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\",\"bytes\":5}\n\n### 写入记录（UTF-8 文本载荷）\nPOST http://127.0.0.1:8080/records\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\"data\":\"plain text, 你好\"}\n\n# curl:\n# curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/records --data '{\"data\":\"plain text\"}'\n\n### 读取\nGET http://127.0.0.1:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1\n\n# curl:\n# curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1'\n# -> {\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\",\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\",\"bytes\":5}\n\n### 同长度原地改写（\"Hello\" 5 字节 -> \"Aloha\" 5 字节）\nPUT http://127.0.0.1:8080/records\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\",\"data_hex\":\"416c6f6861\"}\n\n# curl:\n# curl -s -X PUT http://127.0.0.1:8080/records \\\n#   -d '{\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\",\"data_hex\":\"416c6f6861\"}'\n# 长度不同会返回 422 length_mismatch；改大小请“删除后重新写入”（得到新代次）。\n\n### 释放\nDELETE http://127.0.0.1:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1\n\n# curl:\n# curl -s -X DELETE 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1'\n\n### 重复释放 / 旧句柄读取 -> 409 stale_handle\nDELETE http://127.0.0.1:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1\n\n### 槽位被新记录复用后，旧句柄 p0.s0.g1 仍然读到 409（代次不匹配）\nPOST http://127.0.0.1:8080/records\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{\"data_hex\":\"6e6577\"}\n\n### 压缩全部页（也可 {\"page\":0} 只压缩第 0 页）\nPOST http://127.0.0.1:8080/compact\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{}\n\n# curl:\n# curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/compact -d '{}'\n# -> {\"compacted\":true,\"relocated_bytes\":…}\n\n### 统计\nGET http://127.0.0.1:8080/stats\n\n# 返回页计数、块大小、累计分配次数、存活记录/字节、空闲字节/区间数、每页明细。\n\n### 区间分区快照（free/live 互不相交且恰好覆盖数据区）\nGET http://127.0.0.1:8080/partitions\n\n### 进程内关闭并重新打开文件（重读全部 CRC 与分区不变量）\nPOST http://127.0.0.1:8080/reopen\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{}\n\n### 进程外校验（不启动服务）\n###   cargo run -- check --file /tmp/pfa.db --block-size 4096\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_8041128c93c0299465af1ee5","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3550,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":105272,"output_tokens":1196,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"9258ac89-89f5-4219-959b-eacd4bf2bea3","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:44:36.357Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

Injectable I/O layer.\n2\t//!\n3\t//! All disk access goes through the [`Storage`] trait. Two real implementations\n4\t//! are provided ([`FileStorage`], backed by an `std::fs::File`, and\n5\t//! The allocator itself is\n7\t//! generic over `Storage`, so the very same code paths used against a real file\n8\t//! can be driven through simulated faults in tests.\n9\t//!\n10\t//! ## Sync boundary\n11\t//!\n12\t//! The repository persists exactly one page (or the file header) per\n13\t//! [`Storage::write`] call, and [`Storage::sync`] maps to `fsync`\n14\t//! (`File::sync_all`). A logical mutation is therefore:\n15\t//!\n16\t//! 1. modify the in-memory page;\n17\t//! 2. one `write` of the whole fixed-size page to its deterministic offset;\n18\t//! 3. optionally one `sync`.\n19\t//!\n20\t//! No operation spans multiple page writes (compaction rewrites only the page\n21\t//! it compacts), so a single page write + checksum is the crash-atomicity\n22\t//! unit. A torn write is detected by the per-page CRC on the next open.\n23\t\n24\tuse std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};\n25\tuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\n26\tuse std::path::Path;\n27\tuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n28\t\n29\t/// Random-access block device with a fixed block size and explicit sync.\n30\tpub trait Storage: Send {\n31\t    /// Block (page) size in bytes.\n32\t    fn block_size(&self) -> u32;\n33\t\n34\t    /// File length in bytes.\n35\t    fn len(&self) -> u64;\n36\t\n37\t    /// Is the backing storage empty (zero bytes)?\n38\t    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n39\t        self.len() == 0\n40\t    }\n41\t\n42\t    /// Read `block_size` bytes for block index `block_no` into `buf`.\n43\t    /// Returns an error if the block is past end of file or is short.\n44\t    fn read_block(&mut self, block_no: u32, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n45\t\n46\t    /// Write exactly `buf.len()` bytes at block index `block_no`, extending the\n47\t    /// file if needed. `buf` is exactly one block.\n48\t    fn write_block(&mut self, block_no: u32, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n49\t\n50\t    /// Persist previously written data to stable storage (`fsync`).\n51\t    fn sync(&mut self) -> io::Result<()>;\n52\t}\n53\t\n54\t/// Real, file-backed storage. Block 0 is reserved for the file header; page\n55\t/// `pid` lives at byte offset `header_size + pid * block_size`.\n56\tpub struct FileStorage {\n57\t    file: File,\n58\t    block_size: u32,\n59\t    len: u64,\n60\t}\n61\t\n62\timpl FileStorage {\n63\t    /// Open (creating if absent) the file at `path`.\n64\t    pub fn open(path: &Path, block_size: u32) -> io::Result<Self> {\n65\t        let file = OpenOptions::new()\n66\t            .read(true)\n67\t            .write(true)\n68\t            .create(true)\n69\t            .truncate(false)\n70\t            .open(path)?;\n71\t        let len = file.metadata()?.len();\n72\t        Ok(Self {\n73\t            file,\n74\t            block_size,\n75\t            len,\n76\t        })\n77\t    }\n78\t}\n79\t\n80\timpl Storage for FileStorage {\n81\t    fn block_size(&self) -> u32 {\n82\t        self.block_size\n83\t    }\n84\t\n85\t    fn len(&self) -> u64 {\n86\t        self.len\n87\t    }\n88\t\n89\t    fn read_block(&mut self, block_no: u32, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n90\t        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), self.block_size as usize);\n91\t        let offset = block_no as u64 * self.block_size as u64;\n92\t        if offset + self.block_size as u64 > self.len {\n93\t            return Err(io::Error::new(\n94\t                io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n95\t                format!(\"block {block_no} past end of file (len {})\", self.len),\n96\t            ));\n97\t        }\n98\t        self.file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset))?;\n99\t        self.file.read_exact(buf)?;\n100\t        Ok(())\n101\t    }\n102\t\n103\t    fn write_block(&mut self, block_no: u32, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n104\t        debug_assert_eq!(buf.len(), self.block_size as usize);\n105\t        let offset = block_no as u64 * self.block_size as u64;\n106\t        self.file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset))?;\n107\t        self.file.write_all(buf)?;\n108\t        self.len = self.len.max(offset + buf.len() as u64);\n109\t        Ok(())\n110\t    }\n111\t\n112\t    fn sync(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n113\t        self.file.sync_all()\n114\t    }\n115\t}\n116\t\n117\t/// In-memory storage — fast path for tests and for the reference checks.\n118\t#[derive(Default)]\n119\tpub struct MemStorage {\n120\t    data: Vec<u8>,\n121\t    block_size: u32,\n122\t}\n123\t\n124\timpl MemStorage {\n125\t    pub fn new(block_size: End-to-end HTTP test: a real server thread on an ephemeral port, driven\n//! over raw HTTP/1.1 with `TcpStream` (no client dependencies).\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse pfa::http::TestServer;\n\nstatic SEQ: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n\nfn temp_db() -> PathBuf {\n    let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .unwrap()\n        .as_nanos();\n    let seq = SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"pfa-test-{}-{}-{}.db\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        nanos,\n        seq\n    ));\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&p);\n    p\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn request(addr: &str, method: &str, target: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    let body = body.unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let req = format!(\n        \"{method} {target} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n        body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(req.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut raw = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut raw).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw);\n    let (head, body_part) = text.split_once(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap_or((&text, \"\"));\n    let status = head\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    Resp {\n        status,\n        body: body_part.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn extract_str<'a>(json: &'a str, key: &str) -> &'a str {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\\\"\");\n    let start = json.find(&pat).expect(\"key present\") + pat.len();\n    let rest = &json[start..];\n    let end = rest.find('\"').unwrap();\n    &rest[..end]\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn full_lifecycle_over_http() {\n    let path = temp_db();\n    let srv = TestServer::start(path.clone(), 256).unwrap();\n    let addr = srv.addr().to_string();\n\n    // health\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/health\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"\"));\n\n    // put two records (hex payload + plain UTF-8 payload)\n    let r = request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let h1 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n    let r = request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/records\", Some(r#\"{\"data\":\"plain text\"}\"#));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let h2 = extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n\n    // get back both\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(\n        r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"48656c6c6f\\\"\"),\n        \"body: {}\",\n        r.body\n    );\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h2}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(\n        r.body.contains(\"plain text\"),\n        \"UTF-8 payload round-trip: {}\",\n        r.body\n    );\n\n    // overwrite in place (same length: \"Hello\" -> \"Aloha\")\n    let r = request(\n        &addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"416c6f6861\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"416c6f6861\\\"\"));\n\n    // length mismatch -> 422\n    let r = request(\n        &addr,\n        \"PUT\",\n        \"/records\",\n        Some(&format!(r#\"{{\"handle\":\"{h1}\",\"data_hex\":\"00\"}}\"#)),\n    );\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 422, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // free, then double-free and stale read -> 409\n    let r = request(&addr, \"DELETE\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    let r = request(&addr, \"DELETE\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"double free must be 409, got {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h1}\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 409, \"stale read must be 409\");\n\n    // stats + partitions\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/stats\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"page_count\\\":1\"));\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/partitions\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"kind\\\":\\\"free\\\"\"));\n\n    // compact + in-process reopen survive\n    let r = request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/compact\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    let r = request(&addr, \"POST\", \"/reopen\", Some(\"{}\"));\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"body: {}\", r.body);\n\n    // unknown route -> 400; missing param -> 400\n    let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", \"/nope\", None);\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 400);\n    let r = request(&addr, extract_str(&r.body, \"handle\").to_string();\n        let r = request(&addr, \"GET\", &format!(\"/records?handle={h}\"), None);\n        assert!(r.body.contains(\"cafef00d\"));\n        // {"parentUuid":"37337e22-1d23-4a9e-b9f3-0e7688ca0c10","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"5c08644c-b399-41a4-8323-d05f846f4cb1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_e88dup3ze4v2j700yo09klcg","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//! Shared test helpers.\n2\t#![allow(dead_code)]\n3\t\n4\tuse pfa::page::{Page, PAGE_HEADER_LEN, SLOT_LEN};\n5\tuse pfa::reference::ModelPage;\n6\tuse pfa::repo::Repository;\n7\tuse pfa::{PartitionPiece, Storage};\n8\t\n9\t/// Deterministic xorshift PRNG so randomized tests are reproducible.\n10\tpub struct Rng(u64);\n11\t\n12\timpl Rng {\n13\t    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {\n14\t        Rng(seed.max(1))\n15\t    }\n16\t    pub fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n17\t        let mut x = self.0;\n18\t        x ^= x << 13;\n19\t        x ^= x >> 7;\n20\t        x ^= x << 17;\n21\t        self.0 = x;\n22\t        x\n23\t    }\n24\t    pub fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> usize {\n25\t        (self.next_u64() % n) as usize\n26\t    }\n27\t    pub fn chance(&mut self, pct: u64) -> bool {\n28\t        self.next_u64() % 100 < pct\n29\t    }\n30\t}\n31\t\n32\t/// Build a deterministic payload: `tag` byte repeated, with an 8-byte big\n33\t/// endian nonce prefix so different allocations are distinguishable after\n34\t/// recycling.\n35\tpub fn payload(seed: u64, len: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n36\t    let tag = (seed as u8) ^ 0xA5;\n37\t    let mut v = vec![tag; len];\n38\t    v[..8.min(len)].copy_from_slice(&seed.to_be_bytes()[..8.min(len)]);\n39\t    v\n40\t}\n41\t\n42\t/// Data region boundaries for a page decoded under `block_size` with the given\n43\t/// number of slots.\n44\tpub fn data_region(slot_count: usize, block_size: u32) -> (u32, u32) {\n45\t    (\n46\t        PAGE_HEADER_LEN + SLOT_LEN * slot_count as u32,\n47\t        block_size - 4,\n48\t    )\n49\t}\n50\t\n51\t/// Build/refresh a [`ModelPage`] view directly from a live [`Page`] snapshot:\n52\t/// the model takes the allocator's offsets but keeps its own expectations\n53\t/// about sizes/labels; the harness uses this to check partition conservation.\n54\tpub fn model_from_page(page: &Page) -> ModelPage {\n55\t    let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), page.block_size());\n56\t    let mut mp = ModelPage::new(ds, de);\n57\t    for piece in page.partition_snapshot() {\n58\t        if let PartitionPiece::Live {\n59\t            start,\n60\t            end,\n61\t            slot,\n62\t            gen,\n63\t        } = piece\n64\t        {\n65\t            mp.note_allocated(slot, gen, start, &vec![0u8; Shared test helpers.\n#![allow(dead_code)]\n\nuse pfa::page::{Page, PAGE_HEADER_LEN, SLOT_LEN};\nuse pfa::reference::ModelPage;\nuse pfa::repo::Repository;\nuse pfa::{PartitionPiece, Storage};\n\n/// Deterministic xorshift PRNG so randomized tests are reproducible.\npub struct Rng(u64);\n\nimpl Rng {\n    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {\n        Rng(seed.max(1))\n    }\n    pub fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        let mut x = self.0;\n        x ^= x << 13;\n        x ^= x >> 7;\n        x ^= x << 17;\n        self.0 = x;\n        x\n    }\n    pub fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> usize {\n        (self.next_u64() % n) as usize\n    }\n    pub fn chance(&mut self, pct: u64) -> bool {\n        self.next_u64() % 100 < pct\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build a deterministic payload: `tag` byte repeated, with an 8-byte big\n/// endian nonce prefix so different allocations are distinguishable after\n/// recycling.\npub fn payload(seed: u64, len: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let tag = (seed as u8) ^ 0xA5;\n    let mut v = vec![tag; len];\n    v[..8.min(len)].copy_from_slice(&seed.to_be_bytes()[..8.min(len)]);\n    v\n}\n\n/// Data region boundaries for a page decoded under `block_size` with the given\n/// number of slots.\npub fn data_region(slot_count: usize, block_size: u32) -> (u32, u32) {\n    (\n        PAGE_HEADER_LEN + SLOT_LEN * slot_count as u32,\n        block_size - 4,\n    )\n}\n\n/// Build/refresh a [`ModelPage`] view directly from a live [`Page`] snapshot:\n/// the model takes the allocator's offsets but keeps its own expectations\n/// about sizes/labels; the harness uses this to check partition conservation.\npub fn model_from_page(page: &Page) -> ModelPage {\n    let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), page.block_size());\n    let mut mp = ModelPage::new(ds, de);\n    for piece in page.partition_snapshot() {\n        if let PartitionPiece::Live {\n            start,\n            end,\n            slot,\n            gen,\n        } = piece\n        {\n            mp.note_allocated(slot, gen, start, &vec![0u8; (end - start) as usize])\n                .expect(\"model: page snapshot not a valid partition\");\n        }\n    }\n    mp\n}\n\n/// Verify the partition of every page of an open repository against the\n/// reference model: no overlap, exact cover, conservation.\npub fn assert_partitions<S: Storage>(repo: &Repository<S>) {\n    for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n        let page = repo.page(pid).expect(\"page exists\");\n        page.verify_partition().expect(\"allocator partition invariant\");\n        let mp = model_from_page(page);\n        mp.check_snapshot(&page.partition_snapshot())\n            .expect(\"reference model agrees with allocator\");\n        mp.check_conservation().expect(\"space conserved\");\n    }\n}\n\n/// Store-wide space accounting: per page, data region size == live + free.\npub fn assert_space_accounting<S: Storage>(repo: &Repository<S>) {\n    for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n        let page = repo.page(pid).unwrap();\n        let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), page.block_size());\n        let live: u32 = page\n            .partition_snapshot()\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|p| match p {\n                PartitionPiece::Live { start, end, .. } => Some(end - start),\n                _ => None,\n            })\n            .sum();\n        assert_eq!(\n            live + page.free_bytes() as u32,\n            de - ds,\n            \"page {pid}: live + free != data region\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n","numLines":105,"startLine":1,"totalLines":105}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"37337e22-1d23-4a9e-b9f3-0e7688ca0c10","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

from first principles.\n#[derive(Default, Debug)]\npub struct Ledger {\n    /// Live payload bytes keyed by handle (page, slot, gen).\n    live: HashMap<(u32, u32, u32), usize>,\n    /// Highest slot Self {\n        Rng(seed.max(1))\n    }\n    pub fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        let mut x = self.0;\n        x ^= x << 13;\n        x ^= x >> 7;\n        x ^= x << 17;\n        self.0 = x;\n        x\n    }\n    pub fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> usize {\n        (self.next_u64() % n) as usize\n    }\n    pub fn chance(&mut self, pct: u64) -> bool {\n        self.next_u64() % 100 < pct\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build a deterministic payload: `tag` byte repeated, with an 8-byte big\n/// endian nonce prefix so different allocations are distinguishable after\n/// recycling.\npub fn payload(seed: u64, len: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let tag = (seed as u8) ^ 0xA5;\n    let mut v = vec![tag; len];\n    v[..8.min(len)].copy_from_slice(&seed.to_be_bytes()[..8.min(len)]);\n    v\n}\n\n/// Data region boundaries for a page decoded under `block_size` with the given\n/// number of slots.\npub fn data_region(slot_count: usize, block_size: u32) -> (u32, u32) {\n    (\n        PAGE_HEADER_LEN + SLOT_LEN * slot_count as u32,\n        block_size - 4,\n    )\n}\n\n/// Build/refresh a [`ModelPage`] view directly from a live [`Page`] snapshot:\n/// the model takes the allocator's offsets but keeps its own expectations\n/// about sizes/labels; the harness uses this to check partition conservation.\npub fn model_from_page(page: &Page) -> ModelPage {\n    let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), page.block_size());\n    let mut mp = ModelPage::new(ds, de);\n    for piece in page.partition_snapshot() {\n        if let PartitionPiece::Live {\n            start,\n            end,\n            slot,\n            gen,\n        } = piece\n        {\n            mp.note_allocated(slot, gen, start, &vec![0u8; (end - start) as usize])\n                .expect(\"model: page snapshot not a valid partition\");\n        }\n    }\n    mp\n}\n\n/// Verify the partition of every page of an open repository against the\n/// reference model: no overlap, exact cover, conservation.\npub fn assert_partitions<S: Storage>(repo: &Repository<S>) {\n    for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n        let page = repo.page(pid).expect(\"page exists\");\n        page.verify_partition().expect(\"allocator partition invariant\");\n        let mp = model_from_page(page);\n        mp.check_snapshot(&page.partition_snapshot())\n            .expect(\"reference } => Some(end - start),\n                _ => None,\n            })\n            .sum();\n        assert_eq!(\n            live + page.free_bytes() as u32,\n            de - ds,\n            \"page {pid}: live + free != data region\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n/// Test-side independent ledger.\n///\n/// Unlike `model_from_page` (which consumes allocator-produced offsets), this\n/// ledger only A crash between the two writes\n    /// leaves an orphan trailing page that the old header simply ignores; the\n    /// store remains openable. The header write is the commit point.\n    fn append_page(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let pid = self.pages.len() as u32;\n        let page = Page::format(pid, self.block_size)?;\n        // 1. Persist the unreferenced new page.\n        self.storage.write_block(pid + 1, page.encode())?;\n        // 2. Fault-injection tests: simulated disk errors, corrupted/torn pages and\n//! fsync failures, delivered through the injectable I/O layer.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse pfa::err::Error;\nuse pfa::io::{FaultKind, FaultOp, FaultyStorage, MemStorage};\nuse pfa::repo::Repository;\n\nconst BS: u32 = 256;\n\nfn faulty() -> (\n    Repository<FaultyStorage>,\n    std::sync::Arc<std::sync::Mutex<pfa::io::FaultPolicy>>,\n) {\n    let (st, policy) = FaultyStorage::wrap(MemStorage::new(BS));\n    // create() itself performs the header write + sync; no faults scheduled.\n    let repo = Repository::create(st, BS).unwrap();\n    (repo, policy)\n}\n\n/// An injected write failure on a mutation propagates as an I/O error.\n#[test]\nfn injected_write_error_propagates() {\n    let (mut r, policy) = faulty();\n    r.put(b\"first\").unwrap();\n    policy\n        .lock()\n        .unwrap()\n        .fail_next(FaultOp::Write, \"simulated write failure\");\n    let err = r.put(b\"second\");\n    assert!(matches!(err, Err(Error::Io(_))), \"got {err:?}\");\n}\n\n/// An injected sync failure propagates (the durability boundary is real).\n#[test]\nfn injected_sync_error_propagates() {\n    let (mut r, policy) = faulty();\n    policy\n        .lock()\n        .unwrap()\n        .fail_next(FaultOp::Sync, \"simulated fsync failure\");\n    let err = r.put(b\"synced?\");\n    assert!(matches!(err, Err(Error::Io(_))), \"got {err:?}\");\n}\n\n/// With durability disabled, injected sync faults do not affect correctness\n/// (the sync boundary is opt-out for tests/batch ingestion).\n#[test]\nfn no_sync_mode_ignores_sync_faults() {\n    let (st, policy) = FaultyStorage::wrap(MemStorage::new(BS));\n    let mut r = Repository::create(st, BS).unwrap();\n    r.set_durable(false);\n    policy\n        .lock()\n        .unwrap()\n        .fail_next(FaultOp::Sync, \"should never be observed\");\n    let h = r.put(b\"batched\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(r.get(h).unwrap(), b\"batched\");\n}\n\n/// A bit flip in a persisted page is detected by CRC on reopen as\n/// [`Error::Corrupt`] rather than being read as data.\n#[test]\nfn torn_page_detected_by_crc_on_reopen() {\n    let (st, policy) = FaultyStorage::wrap(MemStorage::new(BS));\n    let mut r = Repository::create(st, BS).unwrap();\n    r.set_durable(false); // avoid the post-write fsync fault timing\n    r.put(b\"alpha-record\").unwrap();\n    // Corrupt one byte inside the next page write's record area.\n    policy.lock().unwrap().corrupt_next_write(100);\n    let h2 = r.put(b\"beta-record\").unwrap();\n    let _ = h2;\n    let storage = r.into_storage();\n    let reopened = Repository::open(storage, BS);\n    match reopened {\n        Err(Error::Corrupt(msg)) => {\n            assert!(msg.contains(\"CRC\"), \"unexpected corrupt detail: {msg}\");\n        }\n        other => panic!(\"expected CRC corruption error, got {other:?}\"),\n    }\n}\n\n/// A bit flip in the FILE HEADER is likewise detected.\n#[test]\nfn torn_header_detected_on_reopen() {\n    let (st, policy) = FaultyStorage::wrap(MemStorage::new(BS));\n    let mut r = Repository::create(st, BS).unwrap();\n    r.set_durable(false);\n    // A 30-byte record costs 42 bytes incl. its slot; page 0 holds exactly\n    // five. The sixth forces a page-1 append (header rewrite).\n    for _ in 0..6 {\n        r.put(&[0u8; 30]).unwrap();\n    }\n    assert_eq!(r.page_count(), 2);\n    // Fill page 1 to the brim without faults: it currently holds one record,\n    // four more fit.\n    for _ in 0..4 {\n        r.put(&[0u8; 30]).unwrap();\n    }\n    // Next put appends page 2; appending writes the HEADER block first, so the\n    // first scheduled write corruption lands in the header (byte 5 = version).\n    policy.lock().unwrap().corrupt_next_write(5);\n    let _ = r.put(&[0u8; 追加新页是唯一触碰两个块的操作：**先写文件头（页数 +1），再写新页**。\n 若两步之间崩溃，最坏情况是留下一个未被引用的尾页；以 CRC 保护的文件头\n 页数为准重新打开。","newString":"- 追加新页是唯一触碰两个块的操作，采用“原子指针”顺序：**先写新页**\n  （此刻无任何引用），**再更新文件头的页数**。若两步之间崩溃，最坏只留下\n  一个被旧文件头忽略的孤立尾页，数据库仍可正常打开；文件头写入是提交点。","originalFile":"# pfa — 页级空闲空间分配器（纯后端）\n\n一个用 Rust 实现的、**文件支持的**可变长记录存储库，外加一个用于本地验证的\n零依赖 HTTP 入口。核心演示内容：\n\n- 可变长记录的**槽位页（slotted page）分配器**；\n- 空闲区由互不相交的**字节区间**表示，分配时**分裂**、释放时**相邻合并**；\n- 记录句柄 `Handle = (page, slot, generation)` 携带**代次**：槽位可复用，\n  但删除后旧句柄（use-after-free / double-free）一律被拒绝；\n- **页内压缩（compaction）**只搬移字节偏移，槽位号与代次不变，所有未失效\n  句柄的语义保持有效；\n- 明确的**磁盘格式**与**同步边界**：每个逻辑修改 = 一次整块写入（+ 可选\n  `fsync`），页尾 CRC-32 使撕裂写/位翻转在重新打开时被检出；\n- **可注入 I/O 层**：真实文件、内存镜像、以及可按计划注入 I/O 错误和字节\n  损坏的装饰器，故障测试走与生产完全相同的分配器代码路径；\n- **区间参考模型**：与分配器实现相互独立，随机差分测试逐步校验\n  “无重叠 + 空间守恒 + 句柄/载荷语义”。\n\n无任何第三方 crate 依赖（仅 Rust 标准库）。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```text\nCargo.toml\nsrc/\n  main.rs       CLI 入口（serve / check）\n  lib.rs        crate 导出\n  crc.rs        CRC-32（IEEE，poly 0xEDB88320）\n  io.rs         Storage trait：FileStorage / MemStorage / FaultyStorage\n  page.rs       槽位页：区间分裂合并、代次、压缩、分区不变量\n  repo.rs       文件支持的仓库：文件头、多页、同步边界\n  handle.rs     句柄类型 p<page>.s<slot>.g<gen>\n  reference.rs  区间参考模型\n  err.rs        错误类型\n  http.rs       零依赖本地 HTTP/1.1 验证服务\ntests/\n  common/mod.rs    测试辅助（确定性 PRNG、分区/守恒断言）\n  acceptance.rs    碎片化、重复释放、旧句柄、压缩、随机差分\n  faults.rs        故障注入（写错、fsync 错、位翻转、重读校验）\n  http_api.rs      真实 TCP 端到端测试\nexamples/\n  requests.http    HTTP 请求样例\nREADME.md\nRUN_LOG.md        实际运行命令与结果记录\n```\n\n## 磁盘格式\n\n所有整数均为小端序。块大小 `block_size` 可配置（默认 4096；测试常用 256\n以快速制造碎片）。\n\n### 文件布局\n\n| 文件块 | 内容 |\n|---|---|\n| 0 | 文件头（占满一个块） |\n| `pid + 1` | 页 `pid` |\n\n### 文件头（块 0）\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 0 | 4 | magic `PFAB` (`0x50464142`) |\n| 4 | 4 | 格式版本（当前 `1`） |\n| 8 | 4 | 块大小 |\n| 12 | 4 | 页数 |\n| 16 | 8 | 累计分配次数（摘要值；权威计数在各页头） |\n| 24 … bs-5 | | 保留，填 0 |\n| bs-4 | 4 | 对 `[0, bs-4)` 的 CRC-32 |\n\n### 页格式（块 `pid+1`）\n\n```text\n偏移 0                      页头 16 字节\n偏移 16                     槽位目录：每项 12 字节，向高地址增长\n          …… 空闲/记录数据区（若干互不相交区间）……\n偏移 bs-4                   对 [0, bs-4) 的 CRC-32\n```\n\n页头：\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 0 | 4 | magic `PFA1` (`0x50464131`) |\n| 4 | 4 | 页 id（必须等于其块序号 - 1） |\n| 8 | 2 | 槽位数（含已死槽位） |\n| 10 | 2 | 空闲区间数（加载时重建并与此值核对） |\n| 12 | 4 | 本页累计分配次数 |\n\n槽位项（12 字节）：\n\n| 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 0 | 2 | 记录偏移；`length=0` 时该槽位已死 |\n| 2 | 2 | 记录长度（0 表示死槽位） |\n| 4 | 4 | 代次 generation（每次释放递增；0 保留为“从未签发”） |\n| 8 | 4 | 保留填 0 |\n\n空闲区间**不落盘**：加载时由存活记录重新构建，并与页头记录的区间数比对，\n任何不一致都报 `Corrupt`。\n\n## 同步与崩溃边界\n\n- 普通修改（`put` / `set` / `free` / `compact`）末尾恰好：\n  1. 一次整页 `write_block`（固定偏移、整块、带 CRC）；\n  2. 一次 `sync`（默认映射到 `File::sync_all`，即 `fsync`；`--no-sync`\n     或 `set_durable(false)` 可关闭）。\n- 追加新页是唯一触碰两个块的操作：**先写文件头（页数 +1），再写新页**。\n 若两步之间崩溃，最坏情况是留下一个未被引用的尾页；以 CRC 保护的文件头\n 页数为准重新打开。\n- 撕裂写 / 静默位翻转由页尾与文件头的 CRC-32 在下次打开时检出，报\n  `Corrupt`，不会被当成有效数据解释。\n\n## 分配与碎片策略\n\n- 首次适应（first-fit），在命中的空闲区间**高端**放置记录，因此一次分配\n  至多把一个空闲区间切成一个低端剩余块。\n- 释放时把记录区间插回有序空闲表，并与两侧相邻区间**合并**。\n- 死槽位优先复用（目录不增长）；否则目录从贴邻的头部空闲区间增长 12 字节。\n- `compact` 把存活记录自上而下打包到数据区顶端，空闲区合并为单一区间；\n  **槽位号与代次不变**，仅字节偏移移动，故有效句柄继续可用。\n- 仓库级 `put` 按页序 first-fit；现有页都放不下时追加新页。\n\n## 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\n\n# 启动本地验证服务（默认 127.0.0.1:8080，文件 pfa.db，块大小 4096）\n./target/release/pfa serve --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --file /tmp/pfa.db --block-size 4096\n\n# 校验已有文件并重读所有 CRC / 分区不变量，打印统计\n./target/release/pfa check --file /tmp/pfa.db --block-size 4096\n```\n\n## HTTP 接口\n\n载荷以十六进制字符串 `data_hex` 传输（也支持 UTF-8 的 `data`）。\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| GET | `/health` | 健康检查 |\n| POST | `/records` | 写入：`{\"data_hex\":\"…\"}` → `{\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\"}` |\n| GET | `/records?handle=p0.s0.g1` | 读取（旧句柄 → 409） |\n| PUT | `/records` | 同长度原地改写：`{\"handle\":\"…\",\"data_hex\":\"…\"}` |\n| DELETE | `/records?handle=…` | 释放（重复释放 → 409） |\n| POST | `/free` | 同上，句柄放 JSON body |\n| POST | `/compact` | `{}` 压缩全部页，或 `{\"page\":0}` |\n| GET | `/stats` | 页数、存活记录、空闲字节/区间数、每分配计数 |\n| GET | `/partitions` | 每页 free/live 区间的参考模型快照 |\n| POST | `/reopen` | 关闭并重新打开文件，重放全部校验 |\n\n可直接用 `examples/requests.http` 中的样例（curl 版见下）。\n\n```bash\ncurl -s -X POST localhost:8080/records -d '{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}'\n# {\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\",\"bytes\":5}\n\ncurl -s 'localhost:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1'\n# {\"handle\":\"p0.s0.g1\",\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\",\"bytes\":5}\n\ncurl -s -X DELETE 'localhost:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1'\ncurl -s -X DELETE 'localhost:8080/records?handle=p0.s0.g1'\n# 第二次：HTTP 409 stale_handle（代次已推进，槽位复用也读不到新数据）\n```\n\n## 测试\n\n```bash\ncargo test\n```\n\n测试矩阵：\n\n- **碎片化 → 压缩**：交错分配/释放制造多个小空洞，断言最大空洞小于空闲\n  总量、压缩后合并为单区间且存活句柄载荷不变；\n- **重复释放 / 释放后访问 / 槽位复用后旧句柄访问**：全部以代次判定拒绝；\n- **压缩保持句柄语义**：压缩后、以及关闭重开后，所有有效句柄仍读出原字节；\n- **随机差分（40 个种子 × 400 步）**：分配/读/释放/原地改写/压缩/重开，\n  每一步对照区间参考模型检查无重叠、精确覆盖、空间守恒与载荷一致；\n- **故障注入**：写错误、fsync 错误、`after` 计数定时、页/文件头位翻转后\n  重开被 CRC 捕获、读错误传播；\n- **HTTP 端到端**：真实 TCP 上跑完整生命周期，含服务器重启后文件持久化。\n\n## 范围说明\n\n这是教学/验证性质的后端项目：HTTP 服务只监听本地、单线程互斥、无鉴权，\nJSON 解析仅支持本服务使用的扁平请求体；没有前端。\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":105,"oldLines":9,"newStart":105,"newLines":9,"lines":["   1. 一次整页 `write_block`（固定偏移、整块、带
