{"parentUuid":"d6d9d374-fd89-47af-85f7-0c00f15abc37","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_zohir194lazqq48lspeaq4zr","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b/RUN_LOG.md","content":"# 运行记录（RUN_LOG）\n\n本文件记录实际执行过的命令、输出结果与未通过项。**占位部分会在实际运行\n后替换为真实输出**；如果某项无法运行（例如环境权限问题），会明确标注。\n\n- 日期：2026-09-23\n- 平台：Linux（见 `uname -a` 实际输出，运行后补充）\n- Rust 工具链：运行 `rustc --version` / `cargo --version` 后补充\n- 项目无第三方依赖（仅标准库）\n\n## 1. 编译\n\n命令：\n\n```bash\ncargo build 2>&1\ncargo build --release 2>&1\n```\n\n结果：_（运行后填写：通过 / 警告 / 错误）_\n\n## 2. 自动化测试\n\n命令：\n\n```bash\ncargo test 2>&1\n```\n\n结果：_（运行后填写：通过数、失败数、失败详情与原因）_\n\n测试目标：\n\n- `tests/acceptance.rs`：碎片化 → 压缩、页级分裂合并、重复释放/旧句柄、\n  未知槽位、压缩跨重开持久化、40 种子 × 400 步区间模型差分、\n  分区精确覆盖、分配计数持久化；\n- `tests/faults.rs`：写错误、fsync 错误、页/文件头位翻转后 CRC 检出、\n  读错误、故障 `after` 计数、故障后内部一致性；\n- `tests/http_api.rs`：真实 TCP 全生命周期 + 服务器重启持久化；\n- 单元测试：CRC 已知向量、句柄编解码、参考模型碎片/重叠、\n  以及 `src` 内各模块的 `#[cfg(test)]` 用例。\n\n## 3. 实际文件服务 + HTTP 验证\n\n命令（按序执行，输出运行后补充）：\n\n```bash\n# 3.1 启动服务\n./target/release/pfa serve --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --file /tmp/pfa-demo.db --block-size 4096\n\n# 3.2 健康检查 / 写入 / 读取 / 统计\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/records -d '{\"data_hex\":\"48656c6c6f\"}'\ncurl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/records?handle=<handle>'\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/stats\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/partitions\n\n# 3.3 碎片化与压缩：用小数据制造多页，再释放/压缩，观察 free_intervals 变化\n# 3.4 重复释放 / 旧句柄：第二次 DELETE 与旧 GET 均应返回 HTTP 409\n# 3.5 重开：POST /reopen 后再次 GET 应仍成功\n\n# 3.6 进程外校验\n./target/release/pfa check --file /tmp/pfa-demo.db --block-size 4096\n```\n\n结果：_（运行后填写每条 curl 的真实返回）_\n\n## 4. 未通过项 / 已知限制\n\n_（运行后如实填写；若无失败，明确写“无”。）_\n\n已知设计限制（非缺陷）：\n\n1. 当一次 `put` 的**页写入或 fsync 返回错误**时，内存中的分配已发生但\n   未持久化；该次操作返回 I/O 错误。语义上“整块写入”是持久化边界，\n   后续操作仍在一致的内存分区上进行（由 `consistency_after_failed_write`\n   覆盖）；崩溃后磁盘状态为写入前的完整镜像（CRC 保护）。\n2. 压缩只做**页内**搬移，不跨页迁移记录。\n3. HTTP 服务为本地验证用：单线程、无鉴权，JSON 解析仅支持扁平请求体。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_ece8c8905ae37cdd6405024e","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":855,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":142136,"output_tokens":1078,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"fcfbac12-c1f9-42a2-b24d-2063e7df7da9","timestamp":"2026-09-22T17:26:35.875Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

Shared test helpers.\n#![allow(dead_code)]\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse pfa::handle::Handle;\nuse pfa::page::{Page, PAGE_HEADER_LEN, SLOT_LEN};\nuse pfa::reference::ModelPage;\nuse pfa::repo::Repository;\nuse pfa::{PartitionPiece, Storage};\n\n/// Deterministic xorshift PRNG so randomized tests are reproducible.\npub struct Rng(u64);\n\nimpl Rng {\n    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {\n        Rng(seed.max(1))\n    }\n    pub fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        let mut x = self.0;\n        x ^= x << 13;\n        x ^= x >> 7;\n        x ^= x << 17;\n        self.0 = x;\n        x\n    }\n    pub fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> usize {\n        (self.next_u64() % n) as usize\n    }\n    pub fn chance(&mut self, pct: u64) -> bool {\n        self.next_u64() % 100 < pct\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build a deterministic payload: `tag` byte repeated, with an 8-byte big\n/// endian nonce prefix so different allocations are distinguishable after\n/// recycling.\npub fn payload(seed: u64, len: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let tag = (seed as u8) ^ 0xA5;\n    let mut v = vec![tag; len];\n    v[..8.min(len)].copy_from_slice(&seed.to_be_bytes()[..8.min(len)]);\n    v\n}\n\n/// Data region boundaries for a page decoded under `block_size` with the given\n/// number of slots.\npub fn data_region(slot_count: usize, block_size: u32) -> (u32, u32) {\n    (\n        PAGE_HEADER_LEN + SLOT_LEN * slot_count as u32,\n        block_size - 4,\n    )\n}\n\n/// Build/refresh a [`ModelPage`] view directly from a live [`Page`] snapshot:\n/// the model takes the allocator's offsets but keeps its own expectations\n/// about sizes/labels; the harness uses this to check partition conservation.\npub fn model_from_page(page: &Page) -> ModelPage {\n    let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), page.block_size());\n    let mut mp = ModelPage::new(ds, de);\n    for piece in page.partition_snapshot() {\n        if let PartitionPiece::Live {\n            start,\n            end,\n            slot,\n            gen,\n        } = piece\n        {\n            mp.note_allocated(slot, gen, start, &vec![0u8; (end - start) as usize])\n                .expect(\"model: page snapshot not a valid partition\");\n        }\n    }\n    mp\n}\n\n/// Verify the partition of every page of an open repository against the\n/// reference model: no overlap, exact cover, conservation.\npub fn assert_partitions<S: Storage>(repo: &Repository<S>) {\n    for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n        let page = repo.page(pid).expect(\"page exists\");\n        page.verify_partition().expect(\"allocator partition invariant\");\n        let mp = model_from_page(page);\n        mp.check_snapshot(&page.partition_snapshot())\n            .expect(\"reference model agrees with allocator\");\n        mp.check_conservation().expect(\"space conserved\");\n    }\n}\n\n/// Store-wide space accounting: per page, data region size == live + free.\npub fn assert_space_accounting<S: Storage>(repo: &Repository<S>) {\n    for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n        let page = repo.page(pid).unwrap();\n        let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), page.block_size());\n        let live: u32 = page\n            .partition_snapshot()\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|p| match p {\n                PartitionPiece::Live { start, end, .. } => Some(end - start),\n                _ => None,\n            })\n            .sum();\n        assert_eq!(\n            live + page.free_bytes() as u32,\n            de - ds,\n            \"page {pid}: live + free != data region\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n/// Test-side independent ledger.\n///\n/// Unlike `model_from_page` (which consumes allocator-produced offsets), this\n/// ledger only trusts the handles/data the test itself issued: it tracks live\n/// byte totals per page and the largest slot index ever seen there, and\n/// recomputes conservation from first principles.\n#[derive(Default, Debug)]\npub struct Ledger {\n    /// Live payload bytes keyed by handle (page, slot, gen).\n    live: HashMap<(u32, u32, u32), usize>,\n}\n\nimpl Ledger {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    pub fn note_put(&mut self, h: Handle, len: usize) {\n        self.live.insert((h.page, h.slot, h.gen), len);\n    }\n\n    pub fn note_free(&mut self, h: Handle) {\n        assert!(\n            self.live.remove(&(h.page, h.slot, h.gen)).is_some(),\n            \"ledger: freed handle {h} was not live\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_live(&self, h: Handle) -> bool {\n        self.live.contains_key(&(h.page, h.slot, h.gen))\n    }\n\n    pub fn live_len(&self, h: Handle) -> usize {\n        self.live[&(h.page, h.slot, h.gen)]\n    }\n\n    pub fn iter_live(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (Handle, usize)> + '_ {\n        self.live\n            .iter()\n            .map(|((p, s, g), len)| (Handle::new(*p, *s as usize, *g), *len))\n    }\n\n    /// Independent conservation check, reading only the page's live labels\n    /// (never its free counters): for every page,\n    /// `data region = sum(live payloads) + free bytes`.\n    pub fn assert_conservation<S: Storage>(&self, repo: &Repository<S>, block_size: u32) {\n        // Aggregate live bytes per page from the ledger.\n        let mut live_by_page: HashMap<u32, usize> = HashMap::new();\n        for ((p, _, _), len) in &self.live {\n            *live_by_page.entry(*p).or_insert(0) += len;\n        }\n        for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n            let page = repo.page(pid).unwrap();\n            let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), block_size);\n            let ledger_live = *live_by_page.get(&pid).unwrap_or(&0);\n            let allocator_live: u32 = page\n                .partition_snapshot()\n                .iter()\n                .filter_map(|p| match p {\n                    PartitionPiece::Live { start, end, .. } => Some(end - start),\n                    _ => None,\n                })\n                .sum();\n            assert_eq!(\n                allocator_live as usize, ledger_live,\n                \"page {pid}: allocator live bytes disagree with test ledger\"\n            );\n            assert_eq!(\n                ledger_live + page.free_bytes(),\n                (de - ds) as usize,\n                \"page {pid}: live + free != data region (ledger conservation)\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":64,"oldLines":7,"newStart":64,"newLines":7,"lines":[" pfa::repo::Repository;\nuse pfa::{PartitionPiece, Storage};\n\n/// Deterministic xorshift PRNG so randomized tests are reproducible.\npub struct Rng(u64);\n\nimpl Rng {\n    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {\n        Rng(seed.max(1))\n    }\n    pub fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        let mut x = self.0;\n        x ^= x << 13;\n        x ^= x >> 7;\n        x ^= x << 17;\n        self.0 = x;\n        x\n    }\n    pub fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> usize {\n        (self.next_u64() % n) as usize\n    }\n    pub fn chance(&mut self, pct: u64) -> bool {\n        self.next_u64() % 100 < pct\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build a deterministic payload: `tag` byte repeated, with an 8-byte big\n/// endian nonce prefix so different allocations are distinguishable after\n/// recycling.\npub fn payload(seed: u64, len: usize) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let tag = (seed as u8) ^ 0xA5;\n    let mut v = vec![tag; len];\n    v[..8.min(len)].copy_from_slice(&seed.to_be_bytes()[..8.min(len)]);\n    v\n}\n\n/// Data region boundaries for a page decoded under `block_size` with the given\n/// number of slots.\npub fn data_region(slot_count: usize, block_size: u32) -> (u32, u32) {\n    (\n        PAGE_HEADER_LEN + SLOT_LEN * slot_count as u32,\n        block_size - 4,\n    )\n}\n\n/// Build/refresh a [`ModelPage`] view directly from a live [`Page`] snapshot:\n/// the model takes the allocator's offsets but keeps its own expectations\n/// about sizes/labels; the harness uses this to check partition conservation.\npub fn model_from_page(page: &Page) -> ModelPage {\n    let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), page.block_size());\n    let mut mp = ModelPage::new(ds, de);\n    for piece in page.partition_snapshot() {\n        if let PartitionPiece::Live {\n            start,\n            end,\n            slot,\n            gen,\n        } = piece\n        {\n            mp.note_allocated(*slot, *gen, *start, &vec![0u8; (end - start) as usize])\n                .expect(\"model: page snapshot not a valid partition\");\n        }\n    }\n    mp\n}\n\n/// Verify the partition of every page of an open repository against the\n/// reference model: no overlap, exact cover, conservation.\npub fn assert_partitions<S: Storage>(repo: &Repository<S>) {\n    for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n        let page = repo.page(pid).expect(\"page exists\");\n        page.verify_partition().expect(\"allocator partition invariant\");\n        let mp = model_from_page(page);\n        mp.check_snapshot(&page.partition_snapshot())\n            .expect(\"reference model agrees with allocator\");\n        mp.check_conservation().expect(\"space conserved\");\n    }\n}\n\n/// Store-wide space accounting: per page, data region size == live + free.\npub fn assert_space_accounting<S: Storage>(repo: &Repository<S>) {\n    for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n        let page = repo.page(pid).unwrap();\n        let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), page.block_size());\n        let live: u32 = page\n            .partition_snapshot()\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|p| match p {\n                PartitionPiece::Live { start, end, .. } => Some(end - start),\n                _ => None,\n            })\n            .sum();\n        assert_eq!(\n            live + page.free_bytes() as u32,\n            de - ds,\n            \"page {pid}: live + free != data region\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n/// Test-side independent ledger.\n///\n/// Unlike `model_from_page` (which consumes allocator-produced offsets), this\n/// ledger only trusts the handles/data the test itself issued: it tracks live\n/// byte totals per page and the largest slot index ever seen there, and\n/// recomputes conservation from first principles.\n#[derive(Default, Debug)]\npub struct Ledger {\n    /// Live payload bytes keyed by handle (page, slot, gen).\n    live: HashMap<(u32, u32, u32), usize>,\n}\n\nimpl Ledger {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    pub fn note_put(&mut self, h: Handle, len: usize) {\n        self.live.insert((h.page, h.slot, h.gen), len);\n    }\n\n    pub fn note_free(&mut self, h: Handle) {\n        assert!(\n            self.live.remove(&(h.page, h.slot, h.gen)).is_some(),\n            \"ledger: freed handle {h} was not live\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    pub fn is_live(&self, h: Handle) -> bool {\n        self.live.contains_key(&(h.page, h.slot, h.gen))\n    }\n\n    pub fn live_len(&self, h: Handle) -> usize {\n        self.live[&(h.page, h.slot, h.gen)]\n    }\n\n    pub fn iter_live(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (Handle, usize)> + '_ {\n        self.live\n            .iter()\n            .map(|((p, s, g), len)| (Handle::new(*p, *s as usize, *g), *len))\n    }\n\n    /// Independent conservation check, reading only the page's live labels\n    /// (never its free counters): for every page,\n    /// `data region = sum(live payloads) + free bytes`.\n    pub fn assert_conservation<S: Storage>(&self, repo: &Repository<S>, block_size: u32) {\n        // Aggregate live bytes per page from the ledger.\n        let mut live_by_page: HashMap<u32, usize> = HashMap::new();\n        for ((p, _, _), len) in &self.live {\n            *live_by_page.entry(*p).or_insert(0) += len;\n        }\n        for pid in 0..repo.page_count() {\n            let page = repo.page(pid).unwrap();\n            let (ds, de) = data_region(page.slot_count(), block_size);\n            let ledger_live = *live_by_page.get(&pid).unwrap_or(&0);\n            let allocator_live: u32 = page\n                .partition_snapshot()\n                .iter()\n                .filter_map(|p| match p {\n                    PartitionPiece::Live { start, end, .. } Fault-injection tests: simulated disk errors, corrupted/torn pages and\n//! fsync failures, delivered through the injectable I/O layer.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse pfa::err::Error;\nuse pfa::io::{FaultKind, FaultOp, FaultyStorage, MemStorage};\nuse pfa::repo::Repository;\n\nconst BS: u32 = 256;\n\nfn faulty() -> (\n    Repository<FaultyStorage>,\n    std::sync::Arc<std::sync::Mutex<pfa::io::FaultPolicy>>,\n) {\n    let (st, policy) = FaultyStorage::wrap(MemStorage::new(BS));\n    // create() itself performs the header write + sync; no faults scheduled.\n    let repo = Repository::create(st, BS).unwrap();\n    (repo, policy)\n}\n\n/// An injected write failure on a mutation propagates as an I/O error.\n#[test]\nfn injected_write_error_propagates() {\n    let (mut r, policy) = faulty();\n    r.put(b\"first\").unwrap();\n    policy\n        .lock()\n        .unwrap()\n        .fail_next(FaultOp::Write, \"simulated write failure\");\n    let err = r.put(b\"second\");\n    assert!(matches!(err, Err(Error::Io(_))), \"got {err:?}\");\n}\n\n/// An injected sync failure propagates (the durability boundary is real).\n#[test]\nfn injected_sync_error_propagates() {\n    let (mut r, policy) = faulty();\n    policy\n        .lock()\n        .unwrap()\n        .fail_next(FaultOp::Sync, \"simulated fsync failure\");\n    let err = r.put(b\"synced?\");\n    assert!(matches!(err, Err(Error::Io(_))), \"got {err:?}\");\n}\n\n/// With durability disabled, injected sync faults do not affect correctness\n/// (the sync boundary is opt-out for tests/batch ingestion).\n#[test]","numLines":50,"startLine":1,"totalLines":183}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5e7269e1-912e-47f8-a5f2-54fb37cd1f74","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

{"parentUuid":"b86c1b89-0636-40f3-8abd-37c5a138b94f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_k3xnxtrvnh4qrubmwg89qjbz","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b/scripts/demo.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# End-to-end HTTP demo for pfa: fragmentation, double-free/stale handles,\n# compaction and reopen.\n#\n# Usage:\n#   scripts/demo.sh [addr]        # default http://127.0.0.1:8080\n#\n# Start the server first in another terminal:\n#   ./target/release/pfa serve --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --file /tmp/pfa-demo.db --block-size 256\n#\n# A small block size (256) is used so a handful of records already fragment\n# a page. Requires curl. The demo uses an otherwise empty database; pass a\n# fresh --file to the server for cleanest output.\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\nBASE=\"${1:-http://127.0.0.1:8080}\"\nH='-sS'\n\nsay() { printf '\\n=== %s ===\\n' \"$*\"; }\nreq() { curl $H -X \"$1\" \"$BASE$2\" ${3:+--data \"$3\"} -w '\\n[HTTP %{http_code}]\\n'; }\n\nsay \"health\"\nreq GET /health\n\nsay \"put four small records (hex payloads, 6 bytes each)\"\nfor i in 41 42 43 44; do\n  req POST /records \"{\\\"data_hex\\\":\\\"${i}${i}${i}${i}${i}${i}\\\"}\"\ndone\n\nsay \"stats before free (expect 1 page, 4 live records)\"\nreq GET /stats\n\nsay \"partitions before free (ordered free/live intervals)\"\nreq GET /partitions\n\nsay \"allocate two more, then free records 2 and 4 to create holes\"\nR2=$(req POST /records '{\"data_hex\":\"323232323232\"}' | head -n1)\nR4=$(req POST /records '{\"data_hex\":\"343434343434\"}' | head -n1)\necho \"created $R2 and $R4\"\nH2=$(printf '%s' \"$R2\" | sed -n 's/.*\"handle\":\"\\([^\"]*\\)\".*/\\1/p')\nH4=$(printf '%s' \"$R4\" | sed -n 's/.*\"handle\":\"\\([^\"]*\\)\".*/\\1/p')\nreq DELETE \"/records?handle=$H2\"\nreq DELETE \"/records?handle=$H4\"\n\nsay \"stats after frees (free_intervals grew -> fragmented)\"\nreq GET /stats\nreq GET /partitions\n\nsay \"double-free and stale read of $H2 (expect HTTP 409 stale_handle)\"\nreq DELETE \"/records?handle=$H2\" || true\nreq GET \"/records?handle=$H2\" || true\n\nsay \"compact the store (free region merges to one interval; live handles stay valid)\"\nreq POST /compact '{}'\nreq GET /stats\nreq GET /partitions\n\nsay \"reopen the file in-process (re-checksum every block)\"\nreq POST /reopen '{}'\n\nsay \"stats after reopen (alloc_counter restored from per-page headers)\"\nreq GET /stats\n\nsay \"demo complete\"\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c6282d19af9add981f5c9aee","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1052,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":157496,"output_tokens":898,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"9c345e86-382d-47bd-b995-5dac3e6da19c","timestamp":"2026-09-22T17:56:40.680Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

compaction and reopen.\n#\n# Usage:\n#   scripts/demo.sh [addr]        # default http://127.0.0.1:8080\n#\n# Start the server first in another terminal:\n#   ./target/release/pfa serve --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --file /tmp/pfa-demo.db --block-size 256\n#\n# A small block size (256) is used so a handful of records already fragment\n# a page. Requires curl. The demo uses an otherwise empty database; pass a\n# fresh --file to the server for cleanest output.\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\nBASE=\"${1:-http://127.0.0.1:8080}\"\nH='-sS'\n\nsay() { printf '\\n=== %s ===\\n' \"$*\"; }\nreq() { curl $H -X \"$1\" \"$BASE$2\" ${3:+--data \"$3\"} -w '\\n[HTTP %{http_code}]\\n'; }\n\nsay \"health\"\nreq GET /health\n\nsay \"put four small records (hex payloads, 6 bytes each)\"\nfor i in 41 42 43 44; live handles stay valid)\"\nreq POST /compact '{}'\nreq GET /stats\nreq GET /partitions\n\nsay \"reopen the file in-process (re-checksum every block)\"\nreq POST /reopen '{}'\n\nsay \"stats after reopen (alloc_counter restored from per-page headers)\"\nreq GET /stats\n\nsay \"demo complete\"\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"49af0f9c-27a7-4b3d-bc29-137544f41901","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

A pure-backend, file-backed store for variable-length records:\n4\t//!\n5\t//! - [`page`] implements the slotted page with an explicit free-space region\n6\t//!   (interval split on allocation, merge on free), per-slot generations and\n7\t//!   in-place compaction that preserves live handle semantics.\n8\t//! - [`repo`] implements the file-backed repository with a checksummed header,\n9\t//!   one page per fixed-size block, and a clearly defined sync boundary\n10\t//! A pure-backend, file-backed store for variable-length records:\n//!\n//! - [`page`] implements the slotted page with an explicit free-space region\n//!   (interval split on allocation, merge on free), per-slot generations and\n//!   in-place compaction that preserves live handle semantics.\n//! - [`repo`] implements the file-backed repository with a checksummed header,\n//!   one page per fixed-size block, and a clearly defined sync boundary\n//!   (one whole-page write + optional `fsync` per mutation).\n//! - [`io`] is the injectable I/O layer: real files, in-memory images and a\n//!   fault-injecting decorator used to simulate disk errors and torn writes.\n//! - [`reference`] is an independent interval reference model used by the\n//!   test-suite to prove no-overlap and space-conservation invariants.\n//! - [`http`] exposes a small local HTTP validation endpoint.\n\npub mod crc;\npub mod err;\npub mod handle;\npub mod http;\npub mod io;\npub mod page;\npub mod reference;\npub mod repo;\n\npub use err::{Error, Result};\npub use handle::Handle;\npub use io::{Fault, FaultKind, FaultOp, FaultPolicy, FaultyStorage, FileStorage, MemStorage, Storage};\npub use page::{Page, PartitionPiece};\npub use reference::{Model, ModelPage};\npub use repo::{Repository, Stats};\n","numLines":32,"startLine":1,"totalLines":32}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"cb683503-4b8c-4fd4-a3e7-67c5baa5148b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

   /// Shortcut: fail the next matching operation.\n    pub fn fail_next(&mut self, op: FaultOp, msg: impl Into<String>) {\n        self.schedule(Fault {\n            op,\n            after: 0,\n            kind: FaultKind::Error(msg.into()),\n        });\n    }\n\n    /// Shortcut: corrupt a byte in the next matching write.\n    pub fn corrupt_next_write(&mut self, byte_offset: usize) {\n        self.schedule(Fault {\n            op: FaultOp::Write,\n            after: 0,\n            kind: FaultKind::CorruptBit { byte_offset },\n        });\n    }\n\n    /// Number of matching ops observed so far.\n    pub fn count(&self, op: FaultOp) -> usize {\n        self.log.iter().filter(|o| **o == op).count()\n    }\n\n    fn take_effect(&mut self, op: FaultOp) -> Option<FaultKind> {\n        self.log.push(op);\n        // Find the first fault due for this op; remember the first matching\n        // fault overall to tick its counter if nothing is due yet.\n        let mut due = None;\n        let mut first_match = None;\n        for (i, f) in self.faults.iter().enumerate() {\n            if f.op != op {\n                continue;\n            }\n            if f.after == 0 {\n                due = Some(i);\n                break;\n            }\n            if first_match.is_none() {\n                first_match = Some(i);\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(i) = due {\n            return Some(self.faults.remove(i).kind);\n        }\n        if let Some(i) = first_match {\n            self.faults[i].after -= 1;\n        }\n        None\n    }\n}\n\nimpl FaultyStorage {\n    /// Wrap any storage. Keep the returned policy handle to schedule faults\n    /// from outside.\n    pub fn wrap<S: Storage + Send + 'static>(inner: S) -> (Self, Arc<Mutex<FaultPolicy>>) {\n        let block_size = inner.block_size();\n        let policy = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPolicy::new()));\n        (\n            Self {\n                inner: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Box::new(inner))),\n                block_size,\n                policy: Arc::clone(&policy),\n            },\n            policy,\n        )\n    }\n\n    pub fn policy(&self) -> Arc<Mutex<FaultPolicy>> {\n        Arc::clone(&self.policy)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Storage for FaultyStorage {\n    fn block_size(&self) -> u32 {\n        self.block_size\n    }\n\n    fn len(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().len()\n    }\n\n    fn read_block(&mut self, block_no: u32, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        if let Some(kind) = self.policy.lock().unwrap().take_effect(FaultOp::Read) {\n            if let FaultKind::Error(msg) = kind {\n                return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, msg));\n            }\n        }\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().read_block(block_no, buf)\n    }\n\n    fn write_block(&mut self, block_no: u32, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let effect = self.policy.lock().unwrap().take_effect(FaultOp::Write);\n        if let Some(kind) = effect {\n            match kind {\n                FaultKind::Error(msg) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, msg)),\n                FaultKind::CorruptBit { byte_offset } => {\n                    let mut damaged = buf.to_vec();\n                    if let Some(b) = damaged.get_mut(byte_offset) {\n                        *b ^= 0x01;\n                    }\n                    return self.inner.lock().unwrap().write_block(block_no, &damaged);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().write_block(block_no, buf)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        if let Some(kind) = self.policy.lock().unwrap().take_effect(FaultOp::Sync) {\n            if let FaultKind::Error(msg) = kind {\n                return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, msg));\n            }\n        }\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().sync()\n    }\n}\n","numLines":117,"startLine":230,"totalLines":346}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3cbd1896-9e0b-400e-b598-71ca6e339f07","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

Commands:\n//! - `pfa serve [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080] [--block-size 4096] [--file pfa.db]`\n//!   run the local HTTP validation endpoint.\n//! - `pfa check --file pfa.db [--block-size 4096]`\n//!   open the file, validate the header and every page CRC/partition and\n//!   print statistics.\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::ExitCode;\n\nuse pfa::err::Error;\nuse pfa::io::FileStorage;\nuse pfa::repo::Repository;\n\nstruct Args {\n    addr: String,\n    file: PathBuf,\n    block_size: u32,\n    durable: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for Args {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            addr: \"127.0.0.1:8080\".to_string(),\n            file: PathBuf::from(\"pfa.db\"),\n            block_size: 4096,\n            durable: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn parse_args(argv: &[String]) -> Result<(String, Args), String> {\n    let mut args = Args::default();\n    let mut iter = argv.iter();\n    let cmd = iter.next().cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| \"serve\".to_string());\n    while let Some(a) = iter.next() {\n        match a.as_str() {\n            \"--addr\" => {\n                args.addr = iter\n                    .next()\n                    .ok_or(\"--addr needs a value\")?\n                    .clone();\n            }\n            \"--file\" => {\n                args.file = PathBuf::from(iter.next().ok_or(\"--file needs a value\")?);\n            }\n            \"--block-size\" => {\n                args.block_size = iter\n                    .next()\n                    .ok_or(\"--block-size needs a value\")?\n                    .parse()\n                    .map_err(|_| \"block-size must be a positive integer\")?;\n            }\n            \"--no-sync\" => args.durable = false,\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unknown argument {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok((cmd, args))\n}\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let argv: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();\n    let (cmd, args) = match parse_args(&argv) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"usage: pfa [serve|check] [--addr ADDR] [--file PATH] [--block-size N]\");\n            eprintln!(\"error: {e}\");\n            return ExitCode::from(2);\n        }\n    };\n\n    match cmd.as_str() {\n        \"serve\" => match pfa::http::serve(\n            args.file.clone(),\n            args.block_size,\n            &args.addr,\n            args.durable,\n        ) {\n            Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,\n            Err(Error::Io(e)) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AddrInUse => {\n                eprintln!(\"bind failed: {e}\");\n                ExitCode::from(1)\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"server error: {e}\");\n                ExitCode::FAILURE\n            }\n        },\n        \"check\" => run_check(&args),\n        other => {\n            eprintln!(\"unknown command {other:?} (expected serve or check)\");\n            ExitCode::from(2)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn run_check(args: &Args) -> ExitCode {\n    let storage = match FileStorage::open(&args.file, args.block_size) {\n        Ok(s) => s,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"cannot open {}: {e}\", args.file.display());\n            return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n        }\n    };\n    match Repository::open(storage, args.block_size) {\n        Ok(repo) => {\n            let s = repo.stats();\n            println!(\n                \"OK  file={} block_size={} pages={} alloc_counter={}\",\n                args.file.display(),\n                s.block_size,\n                s.page_count,\n                s.alloc_counter\n            );\n            println!(\n                \"    live_records={} live_bytes={} free_bytes={} free_intervals={}\",\n ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"CHECK FAILED: {e}\");\n            ExitCode::FAILURE\n        }\n `pfa` command-line entry point.\n//!\n//! Commands:\n//! - `pfa serve [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080] [--block-size 4096] [--file pfa.db]`\n//!   run the local HTTP validation endpoint.\n//! - `pfa check --file pfa.db [--block-size 4096]`\n//!   open the file, validate the header and every page CRC/partition and\n//!   print statistics.\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::ExitCode;\n\nuse pfa::err::Error;\nuse pfa::io::FileStorage;\nuse pfa::repo::Repository;\n\nstruct Args {\n    addr: String,\n    file: PathBuf,\n    block_size: u32,\n    durable: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for Args {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            addr: \"127.0.0.1:8080\".to_string(),\n            file: PathBuf::from(\"pfa.db\"),\n            block_size: 4096,\n            durable: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn parse_args(argv: &[String]) -> Result<(String, Args), String> {\n    let mut args = Args::default();\n    let mut iter = argv.iter();\n    let cmd = iter.next().cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| \"serve\".to_string());\n    while let Some(a) = iter.next() {\n        match a.as_str() {\n            \"--addr\" => {\n                args.addr = iter\n                    .next()\n                    .ok_or(\"--addr needs a value\")?\n                    .clone();\n            }\n            \"--file\" => {\n                args.file = PathBuf::from(iter.next().ok_or(\"--file needs a value\")?);\n            }\n            \"--block-size\" => {\n                args.block_size = iter\n                    .next()\n                    .ok_or(\"--block-size needs a value\")?\n                    .parse()\n                    .map_err(|_| \"block-size must be a positive integer\")?;\n            }\n            \"--no-sync\" => args.durable = false,\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unknown argument {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok((cmd, args))\n}\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let argv: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();\n    let (cmd, args) = match parse_args(&argv) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"usage: pfa [serve|check] [--addr ADDR] [--file PATH] [--block-size N]\");\n            eprintln!(\"error: {e}\");\n            return ExitCode::from(2);\n        }\n    };\n\n    match cmd.as_str() {\n        \"serve\" => match pfa::http::serve(\n            args.file.clone(),\n            args.block_size,\n            &args.addr,\n            args.durable,\n        ) {\n            Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,\n            Err(Error::Io(e)) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AddrInUse => {\n                eprintln!(\"bind failed: {e}\");\n                ExitCode::from(1)\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"server error: {e}\");\n                ExitCode::FAILURE\n            }\n        },\n        \"check\" => run_check(&args),\n        other => {\n            eprintln!(\"unknown command {other:?} (expected serve or check)\");\n            ExitCode::from(2)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn run_check(args: &Args) -> ExitCode {\n    if !args.file.exists() {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"no such file: {} (start the server once to create it)\",\n            args.file.display()\n        );\n        return ExitCode::from(2);\n    }\n    let storage = match FileStorage::open(&args.file, args.block_size) {\n        Ok(s) => s,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"cannot open {}: {e}\", args.file.display());\n            return ExitCode::FAILURE;\n        }\n    };\n    match Repository::open(storage, args.block_size) {\n        Ok(repo) => {\n            let s = repo.stats();\n            println!(\n                \"OK  file={} block_size={} pages={} alloc_counter={}\",\n                args.file.display(),\n                s.block_size,\n                s.page_count,\n                s.alloc_counter\n            );\n            println!(\n                \"    live_records={} live_bytes={} free_bytes={} free_intervals={}\",\n                s.live_records, s.live_bytes, s.free_bytes, s.free_intervals\n            );\n            for p in &s.pages {\n                println!(\n                    \"    page {}: live={} ({} bytes), free={} bytes in {} intervals\",\n                    p.pid, p.live_records, p.live_bytes, p.free_bytes, p.free_intervals\n                );\n            }\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"CHECK FAILED: {e}\");\n            ExitCode::FAILURE\n        }\n {"parentUuid":"94e44abd-294b-44d2-b915-e6e58ebd348b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_lub5hyqv1hjtbbcq2mo8dlan","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b/RUN_LOG.md","content":"# 运行记录（RUN_LOG）\n\n本文件记录实际执行过的命令、输出结果与未通过项。\n\n- 日期：2026-09-23\n- 平台：Linux（仓库环境 6.8.0-90-generic）\n- 依赖：无第三方 crate（仅 Rust 标准库）；无需联网下载依赖\n\n## 0. 环境说明（重要，如实记录）\n\n开发会话中，工具侧的“命令安全分类器”（auto mode classifier）长时间处于\n不可用状态：只读命令（`echo`、`find`、`wc`、`ls` 等）可执行，但所有\n`cargo …` / `make …` 调用都在执行**之前**被环境拒绝，报错形如：\n\n> auto_model/urm is temporarily unavailable, so auto mode cannot determine\n> the safety of Bash right now.\n\n因此在本文件生成时，`cargo build` / `cargo test` **尚未能由开发代理实际\n运行**，下面的结果小节在命令真正执行前保持为“待执行”。代码经过逐文件静态\n审查，但“实际编译/运行通过”只有在执行下列命令后才能如实声称。\n请运行（在本项目根目录）：\n\n```bash\ncargo build\ncargo test\n```\n\n或在 Claude Code 提示符中用 `!` 前缀执行，使输出直接进入会话：\n\n```\n! cargo build\n! cargo test\n```\n\n执行后本文件将补登真实输出；若有编译错误或测试失败，会如实记录并修复。\n\n## 1. 编译\n\n命令：\n\n```bash\ncargo build\ncargo build --release\n```\n\n结果：**待执行**（被上述环境分类器故障阻塞；尚未观察到任何编译器输出）。\n\n## 2. 自动化测试\n\n命令：\n\n```bash\ncargo test\n```\n\n结果：**待执行**。\n\n预期测试目标（代码已就位，实际通过数以运行为准）：\n\n- 单元测试\n  - `crc`：CRC-32 已知向量（空串、`\"123456789\"`、`\"a\"`）、流式一致性；\n  - `handle`：`p<page>.s<slot>.g<gen>` 编解码、非法串拒绝；\n  - `reference`：碎片空闲计算、重叠拒绝。\n- `tests/acceptance.rs`\n  - `fragmented_allocation_then_compaction`：制造多空洞、断言\n    `largest hole < total free`、压缩后合并为单区间且存活句柄载荷不变；\n  - `fragmentation_and_merge_via_page_api`：页级碎片→放不进→压缩→放进；\n  - `double_free_and_use_after_free_rejected`：重复释放、释放后读、\n    槽位复用后旧代次句柄全部拒绝；\n  - `unknown_slot_rejected`；\n  - `compaction_survives_reopen`：压缩 + 重开后句柄仍有效；\n  - `differential_against_interval_model`：40 个确定性种子 × 400 步，\n    分配/读/释放/原地改写/压缩/重开，每步做无重叠 + 精确覆盖 + 空间守恒\n    + 独立账本 + 载荷与代次校验；\n  - `free_region_split_and_merge`：分裂与相邻合并的直接检查；\n  - `allocation_counter_persisted`：计数单调且重开后恢复；\n  - `partition_snapshot_covers_exact_region`：分区恰好覆盖数据区。\n- `tests/faults.rs`\n  - 写错误传播、fsync 错误传播、关闭 sync 后不受影响；\n  - 页位翻转 / 文件头位翻转在重开时被 CRC 捕获为 `Corrupt`；\n  - 重开时读错误传播；\n  - 失败写之后内存分区仍自洽、后续操作正常；\n  - 故障 `after` 计数在第 N 次操作触发。\n- `tests/http_api.rs`\n  - 真实 TCP 全生命周期（hex/UTF-8、409 双释放、422 长度不符、stats、\n    partitions、compact、reopen）；\n  - 关闭服务器再以同一文件重启，数据与计数持久化。\n\n## 3. 实际文件服务 + HTTP 验证\n\n步骤（代码与脚本已就位，实际输出待执行后补登）：\n\n```bash\ncargo run --release -- serve --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 \\\n  --file /tmp/pfa-demo.db --block-size 256\n# 另一个终端：\nbash scripts/demo.sh\n# 或按 examples/requests.http 逐条 curl\ncargo run --release -- check --file /tmp/pfa-demo.db --block-size 256\n```\n\n使用 256 字节小块以便少量记录即可观察到碎片与合并。\n\n结果：**待执行**。\n\n## 4. 未通过项 / 已知限制\n\n未通过项：**待执行后如实填写**（当前无法声称编译/测试通过或失败）。\n\n已知设计限制（非缺陷）：\n\n1. 一次 `put` 的页写入或 fsync 返回错误时，内存分配已发生但未持久化，\n   该操作返回 I/O 错误；“整块写入”是持久化边界，崩溃后磁盘为写入前的\n   CRC 保护镜像。故障后内存分区仍自洽（`consistency_after_failed_write`）。\n2. 压缩只做页内搬移，不跨页迁移记录。\n3. HTTP 服务仅供本地验证：单线程互斥、无鉴权，JSON 解析仅支持扁平请求体。\n4. 偏移字段为 u16，块大小上限 65539（65535 数据 + 4 CRC）；默认 4096。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_059e61ef1b57639b68d1d2f7","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1929,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":167736,"output_tokens":1523,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"6d3b9112-f42e-46a6-8cc3-223399a7c6a9","timestamp":"2026-09-22T18:31:27.094Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}

HTTP 服务为本地验证用：单线程、无鉴权，JSON 解析仅支持扁平请求体。\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6d3b9112-f42e-46a6-8cc3-223399a7c6a9","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp9/b","sessionId":"da54941b-fa48-46ef-973e-ac5b8af93c82","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp9-b","slug":"sleepy-tinkering-mccarthy"}
